body:
maya: quick handoff — I\u2019m headed offline in ~10m. ongoing alert: embeddings-queue latency elevated, tokenstore retries increasing. pri: tom, sec: jin. coverage gap note: eu-west shard has smaller headroom; aaron pinged for capacity planning.

maya: incident history tl;dr: around 20:10 we started seeing a steady rise in queue time for embeddings workers, spike correlated with larger batch jobs from partner X. autoscaler didn\u2019t kick for eu-west due to a label mismatch (we patched earlier but still seeing slow scale).

maya: mitigations in progress:
- temporary rate-limit on partner X (applied at gateway) : implemented at 20:22.
- increased embeddings-worker target in us-central by +30% (k8s HPA tweak) at 20:30.
- rolling restart of tokenstore cache nodes in eu-west started 20:40 (watching evictions).

sre-bot: ALERT: embeddings-queue-latency > 2s for 12m (inc 1767254300). Incident severity: P2. Pager sent to oncall.

tom: picking this up as primary. thanks maya — noted the label issue. action plan from me: verify eu-west HPA config, confirm the tokenstore restarts completed, and keep rate-limit in place until queue stabilizes.

jin: on sec. I\u2019ll monitor customer-facing errors and keep the fallback routing ready (route to us-central when eu-west > 70% utilization).

aaron: I\u2019m awake, investigating capacity headroom for eu-west. if we need more GPUs we should open a burst request (I can start that). current quota usage: 83% for gpu-pool-eu.

tom: current metrics snapshot (20:45):
```
embeddings_queue_latency: 2.8s
error_rate_embeddings_ingest: 4.6%
eu-west_cpu_util: 88%
us-central_cpu_util: 62%
```

tom: runbook refs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-queue and playbook section "scale-after-backpressure". short checklist: check HPA labels, validate kube events for pending pods, inspect tokenstore logs for OOMKill.

jin: checked customer impact dashboard — 3 affected customers with elevated latencies (ids: C-118, C-233, C-441). no SLO breach yet but error rate creeping. I've queued a notification draft for SRE->account team if it hits 5%.

maya: note on rollout/fallback: if eu-west continues >85% for 15m, switch partner X traffic to us-central using routing flag (route-override: partner-x -> us-central). tom/jin you have the toggle.

tom: I attempted a HPA patch in eu-west for label selector, it applied but pods are in Pending due to imagePullBackOff for one canary. investigating from 20:48.

jin: ping @sre-bot for logs aggregation: can someone grab tokenstore pod logs for last 10m?

sre-bot: Logs bundle: /artifacts/1767254321/logs_tokenstore_eu_20m.tar.gz (auto-collected).

aaron: regarding burst GPUs, pre-approvals done — I can push a request but lead time ~6-8m after approval. want me to start?

tom: yes please start the burst request now, aaron. also I\u2019m going to drain the canary image to force a new pull; if that fails we fallback to routing change.

maya: action items for night shift (if I don\u2019t come back):
- tom (PRI): continue scaling eu-west and monitor tokenstore restarts. escalate to platform infra if pods remain Pending >10m.
- jin (SEC): watch customer errors and prepare routing override; coordinate with accounts for customer comms if error_rate >=5%.
- aaron: complete burst GPU request and confirm quota increase; post allocation, trigger controlled scale-up of embeddings-workers in eu-west.
- all: keep rate-limit on partner X until queue latency <1s for 10m.

jin: acknowledged. I\u2019ll stand by on routing toggle and notify accounts if threshold hit.

tom: update 20:55 — canary pods pulled successfully after memlimit tweak; new pods are initializing. queue latency dipped to 1.9s momentarily. still watching.

sre-bot: NOTE: Scheduled maintenance window in eu-west at 03:00 UTC — avoid planned restarts during that time.

maya: thanks team. I\u2019m offline now. leave a short summary in this thread when you hand off next shift.

tom: will do. leaving a bookmark with current state and next check at 21:15.

jin: handing off to night shift (when that happens) — will post final status update before logout.

tom: final quick note — checklist link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/embeddings-scale-checklist
